image_description: A small, young wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on a large, flat, white circular object that resembles a tortilla or flatbread. The rabbit has brownish-grey fur with some darker speckling, characteristic of a juvenile cottontail. Its ears are upright but relatively short compared to adults. One foreleg is visible, tucked under the body. The hind legs are mostly obscured by the body's rounded posture. The background shows a glimpse of grey pavement.
